what: Boat wood in two finishes: varnished (tillers, the Sunfish's daggerboard and rudder, washboards) and bare teak (handrails, coaming caps, toe rails, grab rails)

boats.J/22: tiller (laminated ash and mahogany, varnished: Wood), cabin-top handrails and coaming caps (bare teak: Teak), companionway hatch (varnished plywood), kit HandrailTeak
boats.Sunfish: daggerboard top and tiller (varnished: Wood); the rudder blade and daggerboard below deck on older boats; no bare teak
boats.fleet: build_fleet.py Wood and Teak slots (drop boards, eyebrows, handrails) share the same two kinds

closest_camera_note: the helm's eye over the tiller; the hand is on the tiller at 0.3-0.5 m

pattern_mm.grain_line_spacing: see targets.size: the spectral centroid of the grain across it, 1.5-20 mm band

levels_note: All five. Varnish: L0 fresh, L1 hand-wear dulling at the grip, L2 club (amber film worn grey at the grip and edges, a few failed patches), L3 kept 30 years (wood darkened under fresh varnish, no peeling), L4 neglected (varnish peeled to grey wood, black water stains). Teak: L0 golden new, L1 starting to fade, L2 silver-grey with brown patches (Bean's lesson J/22), L3 cleaned and oiled (golden-brown, grain raised), L4 dark grey with black mildew and checks.

replaces.shader: scripts/make_materials.py BOAT_CODE surf 6 (varnish: yellows, then grey patches from ageK) and surf 7 (teak: lerp to grey with ageK); the Grain block
replaces.library: BOAT_LIBRARY Wood (0.30, 0.17, 0.07) r0.30 coat1 and Teak (0.22, 0.19, 0.15) r0.85
replaces.detail_maps: Inputs/boat-detail T_Detail_WoodVarnish_N/_M and T_Detail_TeakWeathered_N/_M (Tools/boats/make_detail_textures.py wood_varnish, teak)
replaces.hero: Inputs/j22-hero/j22_materials.py teak() (baked; style teak.state and varnish.gloss/peel) - follow-up, needs a hero bake

budget.medium: no new maps: shader math only (Medium skips detail maps)
budget.high: reuse the two existing wood map pairs (4 maps, ~8 MB); at most one extra texture read per pixel
budget.frame: boats views no more than 2 fps slower than main on the Mac boats gate
